CA Dream Act Application
guidetextdraw_1642477993.name: textdraw_16424779931651509115224

guidetextdraw._value: You indicated on your California Dream Act Application (CDA) that you are an unaccompanied homeless youth (as defined below) or were self-supporting and at risk of homelessness at any time on or after June 20, 2021. Incomplete documents will not be returned. They will be disposed of in a secure manner, per university policy. This will delay processing.
guidetextdraw.name: textdraw1649837817993

guidetextdraw_1544701376.text: UNACCOMPANIED HOMELESS YOUTH VERIFICATION - HOME (2022-2023)

qualityquantityoralc.jcr:title: Main Panel
qualityquantityoralc.name: MainPanel

guidetextdraw._value:
Definitions to reference for the purpose of completing this form:

  • “Unaccompanied” - you are not living in the physical custody of your parent or guardian.
  • “Homeless” - you are lacking fixed, regular and adequate housing, which includes living in shelters, motels or cars, or temporarily living with other people because you have nowhere else to go. If you are living in any of these situations and fleeing an abusive parent you may be considered homeless even if your parent would provide support and a place to live.
  • "Youth” - you were 21 years of age or younger as of the date you signed the CDA.
guidetextdraw.name: textdraw1649757256910

guidetextdraw_230745440._value: Please complete this form by checking one of the boxes below, attaching the specified documentation, and then signing and submitting it to the Office of Financial Aid.
guidetextdraw_230745440.name: textdraw_2307454401653475013879

guidetextdraw_121448614._value: I was 21 years of age or younger as of the date I signed the CDA. I meet the definition of “unaccompanied homeless youth”, as defined above, and was homeless or at risk of homelessness on or after June 30, 2021. By checking this box, you certify that you are able to provide verification of this status. You must sign this form and provide a written statement from:
guidetextdraw_121448614.name: textdraw_1214486141651558786613

guidetextdraw._value:
• A Mckinney-Vento School District Liaison,
  • A director or designee of a HUD/RHYA-funded shelter, OR
  • A third-party professional who can verify that you meet the definition of unaccompanied youth who was homeless or at risk of homelessness. Examples of third-party professionals include: teachers, counselors, financial aid administrators, medical authorities, members of clergy, social workers, etc. Statements from third-party professionals should include appropriate contact information and should be printed on agency letterhead.
guidetextdraw.name: DeclrationInformationOne

guidetextdraw_1099914994._value:
• Director or designee of an emergency or transitional shelter, or other program serving those experiencing homelessness, OR
  • Your high school or school district homeless liaison or designee, OR
  • Director or designee of a project supported by a federal TRIO or GEAR UP program grant
guidetextdraw_1099914994.name: DeclrationInformationTwo

guidetextdraw_1955503264._value: I was 22 or 23 at the time my CDA was signed but was homeless or at risk of homelessness on or after June 30, 2021. If you are between the ages of 22 to 23 and believe you otherwise meet the criteria of an unaccompanied homeless youth, you may be eligible to have your dependency status updated by the Office of Financial Aid. Please complete and submit this form AND the 2022-2023 Dependency Override Appeal Form, available on the Cal State Fullerton’s financial aid website at www.fullerton.edu/financialaid under “Forms & Appeals”, to the Office of Financial Aid.
guidetextdraw_1955503264.name: textdraw_19555032641649833025813

guidetextdraw_508652369._value: I was NOT homeless or at risk of homelessness on or after June 30, 2021 and will provide parental information on the CDA. You must correct the information on your CDA by providing your parental financial information. You and one parent must sign the CDA and submit it to the State processor. You can do so at https://dream.csac.ca.gov/. A new item will be placed on your To Do List requesting parental information. If applicable, please check this box, sign below & submit to the Office of Financial Aid.
guidetextdraw_508652369.name: textdraw_5086523691649833042610

guidetextdraw_300289891.text: I was 21 years of age or younger as of the date I signed the CDA. I meet the definition of “unaccompanied homeless youth”, as defined above, and was homeless or at risk of homelessness on or after June 30, 2021. By checking this box, you certify that you are able to provide verification of this status. You must sign this form and provide a written statement from:

guidetextdraw_565573174._value: NOTE: If you inadvertently answered "Yes" to being homeless or at risk of homelessness on your CADAA, but do not meet the definitions above, please correct your CADAA by changing the answer to this question and providing parental information. You must submit a CADAA correction before we can continue processing your application.
guidetextdraw_565573174.name: DeclarationNoteText
